Mixed purées

Yellow fish purée

Halacskás sárgapüré

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

No salt and no nutmeg. Check the fish for bones before you blend. This contains fish.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g skinless boneless trout or cod (fresh or plain frozen, not smoked)
  • 200 g sweet potato (peeled weight)
  • 80 g carrot (peeled weight)

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Peel the sweet potato and carrot and cook them in unsalted water until soft.
  2. Add the fish and cook until it is opaque and flakes.
  3. Check the fish and remove every bone.
  4. Blend fish and vegetables until smooth.
  5. Do not add salt or nutmeg.

Adjusted

The usual version salted the fish and added nutmeg. A bone left in the purée is dangerous.

Cook boneless fish with sweet potato and carrot, check for bones, and blend it smooth. Do not add salt, and skip the nutmeg.
